summary: Adds the operator-facing workflow to publish/activate a schema-2 Phase-D recovery payload: prepare_runtime_recovery_payload --phase-d derives every capture input from installed configuration (no protected path ever typed) and attaches it to the current Foundation-E payload; the existing --activate selects it as current. Fixes two real latent mode-normalization gaps this exposed. No protected-runtime change; activation on KOGR is a separate, deliberate step.
